Silkie Chicken Tandoori

Silkie chicken in a spiced yogurt marinade, served with green chutney.

Jump to recipe ↓

What you’ll need

Ingredients

  1. Chicken (Silkie)

Marinade

  1. Mustard Oil
  2. Red Chilli Powder
  3. Cumin
  4. Cardamom
  5. Cinnamon
  6. Yogurt
  7. Lime
  8. Gram Flour
  1. Cilantro

  3. Ginger
  4. Green Chilli

Let’s cook

Method & notes

Prepare the green chutney, marinate the chicken, then cook it.

  1. Prepare the Green Chutney

    Start with the chutney so it can chill while you prepare the chicken.

    Thoroughly rinse the coriander leaves and roughly chop them. Place them in a blender or small grinder jar. Add green chilies, ginger, cumin powder, chaat masala, lemon juice, and salt. Add 1-2 teaspoons of water and blend into a smooth chutney. [2] Adjust water as needed, but avoid making it too thin. Transfer the chutney to a bowl. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

    Keep the chutney covered in the refrigerator until serving.

Chicken tandoori

  1. Prepare the Chicken Tandoori

    In a mixing bowl, whisk together yogurt, ginger paste, garlic paste, olive oil, and all the spices (turmeric, cumin, coriander, garam masala, paprika, chili powder, and salt). Add the chicken pieces to the marinade. Coat well, ensuring all pieces are evenly covered. Cover the bowl and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight (up to 24 hours). For a quick version, let the chicken marinate for 10 minutes.

    [4] Marinade note

    The marinade and resting-time instructions are in step 2. Use this note field to record your own adjustments after cooking.

  2. Cook the Chicken

    Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Line a baking sheet with foil and place a wire rack over it. Remove the chicken from the marinade, shaking off any excess. Arrange the pieces on the wire rack. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred. Use a meat thermometer to check that the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). [3]

    [1] Finished silkie chicken

Serve the chicken with the green chutney prepared in step 1.
